displayName: 简体中文语言包 · Simplified Chinese
description: Use Simplified Chinese across BB menus, settings and built-in panels while keeping project, thread and Git. Includes 5,914 translated strings and preserves dynamic names and placeholders. Chat content, code, terminals and recognized custom titles keep their original text; disabling the plugin restores the interface. Runs locally without a translation API or account; the dictionary targets BB 0.49.0 and requires BB 0.49+.
